brief: Edit the selected first kitten into an elegant star-mist cultivation spirit appearance. Keep it unmistakably the same kitten, same pose and expression. This is a visual concept for the 9mew fantasy universe.

changes.coat_color: Keep cream-white face, chest and paws; add a very subtle pale lilac-to-mint sheen only on the outer haunch and tail tip.
changes.coat_pattern: A few tiny pearlescent star freckles at outer shoulders and tail; no text or symbols resembling letters.
changes.aura: One graceful translucent lilac mist ribbon loosely curls around the tail with generous transparent space; preserve its entire silhouette.
changes.accessories: Keep original sakura silk scarf and small gold four-point star clasp; add one very tiny pearl orbit around the clasp.

target.placement: pet appearance preview, no baked text
